output.summary: The denial can be appealed by referencing the ambulance clause and the existing emergency attestation. The listed precedents do not support the denial.

items.text: Prepare an appeal letter that cites clause C-2026-AMBULANCE (section 6.5) and attach the satisfied Emergency Attestation (code EMERGENCY_ATTESTATION).
The DME precedent does not apply because it concerns durable medical equipment, not ambulance transport, and its governing clause C-2026-DME-NECESSITY is unrelated.
The ER coverage precedent is about emergency department services, not ambulance transport, and its governing clause C-2026-ER-COVERAGE does not govern this claim.
The physiotherapy limit precedent deals with PT services, and the governing clause C-2026-PHYSIO-LIMIT does not cover ambulance transport.
The clinical progress notes precedent relates to physiotherapy and is governed by C-2026-PHYSIO-LIMIT, which is unrelated to ambulance claims.
